why_this_packet_exists: F801 exports the passive same-domain provider skeleton for the alpha_s reference-scale lane.
P802 shows that no active provider action rule is currently exported on that same domain.

target_object.goal: Freeze the exact active-rule object still missing before the passive same-domain skeleton can count as a real provider class.

required_fields.name: provider_skeleton_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to one explicit same-domain provider skeleton.

required_fields.name: support_bundle_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to the already-exported support bundle carried by that skeleton.

required_fields.name: acting_same_domain_input_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must identify the same-domain input on which the active rule acts; foreign-domain inputs are forbidden.

required_fields.name: provider_action_rule_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must export the active rule that makes the passive skeleton act as a provider class.

required_fields.name: semantic_principle_supply_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must state how the active rule supplies the missing semantic principle on the same domain.

required_fields.name: passive_to_active_upgrade_block_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly record why passive support does not auto-upgrade into an active provider class.

required_fields.name: foreign_domain_exclusion_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly fence off foreign-domain reference structures and host-semantics imports.

required_fields.name: selected_provider_class_output_schema
required_fields.hard_limit: Must output the admitted provider-class action and its scope on the alpha_s lane.

required_fields.name: hard_limits
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly deny Standard Model identification, QCD closure, and ToE closure.

current_honest_reading: The current sharp blocker is no longer whether the alpha_s lane has a passive same-domain provider base.
It is the missing active rule that would make that passive base act as a provider class.
F802 freezes that exact missing object without promoting the current skeleton into alpha_s closure.
recommended_next_move: Build one narrow probe testing whether any current same-domain relation inside the passive provider skeleton can be strengthened into alpha_s_reference_scale_provider_action_rule_target_v1 without importing foreign-domain reference structures or new host semantics.
hard_limits: Does not claim that the active rule already exists.
Does not claim that the provider class already exists.
Does not claim that the semantic principle already exists.
Does not claim that the F704 maximum is already a lawful reference-scale point.
Does not claim alpha_s boundary export readiness.
